issues: No signs of getting around the measurement: no file or network access, no pasted answers, and no use of test labels. Only train_y is used for fitting.
No bugs that make the result meaningless. Seeds are derived from the seed argument (seed+i), and featurization and the rest of the pipeline are unchanged.
The candidate makes four changes at once: a 5-model seed bag, extra_trees=True, subsample 0.8->0.7 and colsample_bytree 0.5->0.4. That makes it hard to tell which change did what.
Recomputed z = (0.3653-0.3651)/(0.0037*sqrt(1/1+1/2)) = 0.0002/0.00453 ≈ 0.044, which matches the harness. The gain is far inside the noise, so rejecting it is correct.
The LightGBM part now costs 5 times as much compute for no measurable gain, so it is not worth it under the simpler-is-better rule.
